title: Apple announces a multi-year Google deal to use Gemini and Cloud to power Siri's features in 2026, saying Google's tech "provides the most capable foundation" (Samantha Subin/CNBC)
summary: Samantha Subin / CNBC: Apple announces a multi-year Google deal to use Gemini and Cloud to power Siri's features in 2026, saying Google's tech “provides the most capable foundation” — - Apple is teaming up with Google to use Gemini models for an AI-powered Siri
contentText:
Samantha Subin / CNBC :

Apple signs a multiyear Google deal to use Gemini and Google Cloud to power Siri's features in 2026, saying Google's tech “provides the most capable foundation”   —  Apple is joining forces with Google to power its artificial intelligence features for products such as Siri later this year.
